name: Ryeuie Sou
source:
Born 11/20/2036
A determined and brazen genius girl who skipped grades.
She is especially good at piloting mecha.
She looks down on people that aren't as smart as her so she isn't good at dealing with other people.
Has a bit of a complex about her short height.
